Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added armoury fill percentage bars beside each gear-section focus checkbox. The fill display reads only the matching armoury chest section and ignores normal inventory. Added a Refresh armoury button while keeping the display lightly cached.
